title: PGC Reference Implementation: Governance Surface (software_governance)
description:
The normative platform surface of the Protocol-Governed Computing reference implementation: what a conforming PGC system is allowed to be. Carries the capability-transform and capability-side-effect registry and the governance declarations every composition rests on.

Part of the Protocol-Governed Computing reference corpus. Cite the version DOI of the release you used, not the concept DOI.
notes: Implements or supports the Open PGC Standard (10.5281/zenodo.22150616). Version is taken from the GitHub release tag; do not hard-code it here.
